newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada names MacKay financial task force chair.
newsitem.headline: Canada names MacKay financial task force chair.

text.p: The Canadian government said on Monday that it named Regina lawyer Harold MacKay as the new chairman for its task force on the future of the Canadian financial services sector.
MacKay replaces Toronto lawyer James Baillie, who resigned after a newspaper reported he was tied to Bank of Nova Scotia's proposed takeover of National Trustco Inc last month.

The government said in a statement that MacKay's career had focused on corporate and commercial law and that he had held a number of positions with insight into the broad policy issues facing the financial services sector.
The government said the force's interim chairman Pierre Ducros would become vice-chairman and that it named Toronto lawyer Donald Brown as a new member of the task force.
The task force is expected to issue its final report in September 1998.
